posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: On January 28–29, the Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE), in collaboration with National Anti Doping Agency India hosted a focused workshop on Anti-Doping Research and Education. The intent was clear: India’s anti-doping ecosystem must be shaped by evidence, education, and sustained research, not by compliance alone.

posts.text: IORC has concluded, but the ideas sparked here are only beginning their journey.
